# T1 core-CSS computed-value cases (pinned WPT-area subset).
#
# One `#test` block per case. Each block:
#   #test  <short name>
#   #area  <one of: css/CSS2/normal-flow css/css-box css/css-color css/css-fonts css/css-text>
#   #css   <author stylesheet text (may span the rest of the line)>
#   #html  <html fragment>
#   #path  <tag chain from a root to the element under test, e.g. `html body p`;
#           append `[n]` (0-based) to pick the n-th matching sibling>
#   #expect <property> = <value>   (one or more; property in the vocabulary below)
#
# Property vocabulary (mapped onto the native cascade's ComputedStyle):
#   color, background-color        -> #rrggbb   (or `none` for no background)
#   display                        -> block | inline | none
#   font-size, line-height         -> a number in px
#   font-weight                    -> bold | normal      (maps to ComputedStyle.bold)
#   font-style                     -> italic | normal     (maps to ComputedStyle.italic)
#   text-decoration                -> underline | none    (maps to ComputedStyle.underline)
#   margin-top/right/bottom/left   -> a number in px
#   padding-top/right/bottom/left  -> a number in px
#   font-family                    -> comma-joined family list (or `default` when empty)
#
# Blank lines and `#`-comment lines outside a block are ignored.

# --- css/css-color -----------------------------------------------------------

#test color-hex-longhand
#area css/css-color
#css p { color: #ff0000 }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect color = #ff0000

#test color-hex-shorthand
#area css/css-color
#css p { color: #0f0 }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect color = #00ff00

#test color-named
#area css/css-color
#css p { color: rebeccapurple }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect color = #663399

#test color-rgb-function
#area css/css-color
#css p { color: rgb(0, 100, 0) }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect color = #006400

#test color-inherits-to-child
#area css/css-color
#css body { color: #123456 }
#html <p><em>x</em></p>
#path html body p em
#expect color = #123456

#test background-color-cascades
#area css/css-color
#css div { background-color: #eeeeee }
#html <div>x</div>
#path html body div
#expect background-color = #eeeeee

# --- css/css-fonts -----------------------------------------------------------

#test font-size-em-of-parent
#area css/css-fonts
#css body { font-size: 20px } h1 { font-size: 2em }
#html <h1>x</h1>
#path html body h1
#expect font-size = 40

#test font-size-px-absolute
#area css/css-fonts
#css p { font-size: 18px }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect font-size = 18

#test font-weight-bold-keyword
#area css/css-fonts
#css p { font-weight: bold }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect font-weight = bold

#test font-weight-numeric-700
#area css/css-fonts
#css p { font-weight: 700 }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect font-weight = bold

#test font-style-italic
#area css/css-fonts
#css p { font-style: italic }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect font-style = italic

#test font-family-list
#area css/css-fonts
#css p { font-family: "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect font-family = DejaVu Sans,Arial,sans-serif

#test font-size-percentage-of-parent
#area css/css-fonts
#css body { font-size: 20px } p { font-size: 150% }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect font-size = 30

# --- css/css-box -------------------------------------------------------------

#test margin-shorthand-one-value
#area css/css-box
#css p { margin: 10px }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect margin-top = 10
#expect margin-right = 10
#expect margin-bottom = 10
#expect margin-left = 10

#test margin-shorthand-two-values
#area css/css-box
#css p { margin: 5px 12px }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect margin-top = 5
#expect margin-right = 12
#expect margin-bottom = 5
#expect margin-left = 12

#test margin-longhand-side
#area css/css-box
#css p { margin-left: 24px }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect margin-left = 24

#test padding-shorthand-four-values
#area css/css-box
#css p { padding: 1px 2px 3px 4px }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect padding-top = 1
#expect padding-right = 2
#expect padding-bottom = 3
#expect padding-left = 4

#test padding-em-resolves-against-font-size
#area css/css-box
#css p { font-size: 10px; padding: 2em }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect padding-top = 20

# --- css/CSS2/normal-flow ----------------------------------------------------

#test display-block-default-for-div
#area css/CSS2/normal-flow
#css
#html <div>x</div>
#path html body div
#expect display = block

#test display-inline-default-for-span
#area css/CSS2/normal-flow
#css
#html <span>x</span>
#path html body span
#expect display = inline

#test display-none-hides-element
#area css/CSS2/normal-flow
#css .hidden { display: none }
#html <p class="hidden">x</p>
#path html body p
#expect display = none

#test display-block-override-on-span
#area css/CSS2/normal-flow
#css span { display: block }
#html <span>x</span>
#path html body span
#expect display = block

#test child-combinator-specificity
#area css/CSS2/normal-flow
#css body > p { color: #010203 } p { color: #999999 }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect color = #010203

# --- css/css-text ------------------------------------------------------------

#test text-decoration-underline
#area css/css-text
#css a { text-decoration: underline }
#html <a>x</a>
#path html body a
#expect text-decoration = underline

#test text-decoration-none-removes-ua-underline
#area css/css-text
#css a { text-decoration: none }
#html <a>x</a>
#path html body a
#expect text-decoration = none

#test line-height-px-absolute
#area css/css-text
#css p { line-height: 24px }
#html <p>x</p>
#path html body p
#expect line-height = 24

# A unitless line-height MUST inherit as the MULTIPLIER and recompute against the
# child's own font-size (per CSS). The native T1 cascade currently inherits the
# RESOLVED px instead (see
# work/notes/observations/t1-unitless-line-height-inherits-as-absolute-px.md), so
# this case legitimately FAILS the meter today -- it is a real, known regression
# surface the WPT bar is meant to expose, not tune away.
#test line-height-unitless-inherits-as-multiplier
#area css/css-text
#css body { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.5 } small { font-size: 10px }
#html <p><small>x</small></p>
#path html body p small
#expect line-height = 15
